seoTitle: How to Connect Asana to Notion: Sync Tasks Easily
metaDescription: See how to link Asana with Notion in 2026 using native synced databases, so task updates in either app reflect instantly without manual copying.
intro: Keeping documentation in Notion while managing tasks in Asana usually means duplicate work, but Notion's native Asana integration closes that gap. This guide covers connecting the two accounts and turning a pasted Asana link into a live, bi-directional synced database inside your Notion pages.

steps.heading: Open Notion's Connections settings
steps.body: Go to Settings & Members in Notion and find the native Asana connection option to begin linking your workspace.

steps.heading: Authenticate your Asana account
steps.body: Grant Notion permission to access your Asana workspace so it can read and sync project and task data.

steps.heading: Paste an Asana link into a Notion page
steps.body: Copy a project or task link from Asana, paste it into Notion using the slash command, and choose the option to embed it as a synced database rather than a plain link.

steps.heading: Map fields and customize the view
steps.body: Adjust how Asana properties like assignees, due dates, and status map into Notion database columns so the layout matches how your team works.

steps.heading: Choose your preferred layout
steps.body: Switch the synced database between List, Board, or Table view inside Notion to match the way you review tasks.

faq.question: Do changes in Notion sync back to Asana?
faq.answer: Yes, the native integration is bi-directional, so edits made from either app update the linked record in the other.

faq.question: Can I sync an entire Asana project into Notion?
faq.answer: Yes, pasting a project link and choosing the synced database option pulls in the full task list, not just a single task.

faq.question: Is there a delay before updates appear?
faq.answer: Sync generally happens quickly, but very large projects or heavy simultaneous edits can introduce a short delay before the view refreshes.

faq.question: Does this integration cost extra?
faq.answer: The connection itself is part of both platforms' standard offerings, though your Asana or Notion plan tier may limit certain automation features.
